title: Find Dead Code
summary: Scans the index for code with no references -- candidates to delete
intro: Read this before a cleanup pass or before deleting something you suspect is unused: find-deadcode scans the index for symbols with no references and lists them as candidates. Filter with --kind, add --include-private for private members; also under drag-lint > Code Quality.
